verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a locally run document-conversion CLI and Haskell library, not a hosted service that collects user content, so an AI-training opt-out is not a meaningful axis for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Pandoc collecting data or offering any training-related data controls that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
